<p>Alongside the release of the Kimi K2.6 model, we are open-sourcing the Kimi Vendor Verifier (KVV) project, designed to help users of open-source models verify the accuracy of their inference implementations.</p>
<p>Not as an afterthought, but because we learned the hard way that open-sourcing a model is only half the battle. The other half is ensuring it runs correctly everywhere else.</p>

hover:underline" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">click here</a> to access the Kimi API K2VV evaluation results for calculating the F1 score.</p>
<h2 node="[object Object]">Why We Built KVV</h2>
<p><strong class="font-semibold text-(--Labels-Primary)">From Isolated Incidents to Systemic Issues</strong></p>
<p>Since the release of K2 Thinking, we have received frequent feedback from the community regarding anomalies in benchmark scores. Our investigation confirmed that a significant portion of these cases stemmed from the misuse of Decoding parameters. To mitigate this immediately, we built our first line of defense at the API level: enforcing Temperature=1.0 and TopP=0.95 in Thinking mode, with mandatory validation that thinking content is correctly passed back.</p>
<p>However, more subtle anomalies soon triggered our alarm. In a specific evaluation on <a href="https://www.reddit.com/r/LocalLLaMA/comments/1osglws/kimi_k2_thinking_scores_lower_than_gemini_25/?rdt=41412" class="text-(--Colors-KMBlue) hover:underline" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">LiveBenchmark</a>, we observed a stark contrast between third-party API and official API. After extensive testing of various infrastructure providers, we found this difference is widespread.</p>
<p>This exposed a deeper problem in the open-source model ecosystem: The more open the weights are, and the more diverse the deployment channels become, the less controllable the quality becomes.</p>
<p>If users cannot distinguish between &quot;model capability defects&quot; and &quot;engineering implementation deviations,&quot; trust in the open-source ecosystem will inevitably collapse.</p>
<h2 node="[object Object]">Our Solution</h2>
<p><strong class="font-semibold text-(--Labels-Primary)">Six Critical Benchmarks</strong> (selected to expose specific infra failures):</p>
<ol>
<li><a href="https://github.com/MoonshotAI/Kimi-Vendor-Verifier?tab=readme-ov-file#3-pre-flight-check" class="text-(--Colors-KMBlue) hover:underline" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Pre-Verification</a>: Validates that API parameter constraints (temperature, top_p, etc.) are correctly enforced. All tests must pass before proceeding to benchmark evaluation.</li>
<li><a href="https://github.com/MoonshotAI/Kimi-Vendor-Verifier?tab=readme-ov-file#ocrbench-quick-validation" class="text-(--Colors-KMBlue) hover:underline" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">OCRBench</a>: 5 minutes smoke test for multimodal pipelines.</li>
<li><a href="https://github.com/MoonshotAI/Kimi-Vendor-Verifier?tab=readme-ov-file#mmmu-pro-vision" class="text-(--Colors-KMBlue) hover:underline" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">MMMU Pro</a>: Verify Vision input preprocessing by testing diverse visual inputs.</li>
<li><a href="https://github.com/MoonshotAI/Kimi-Vendor-Verifier?tab=readme-ov-file#aime-2025" class="text-(--Colors-KMBlue) hover:underline" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">AIME2025</a>: Long-output stress test. Catches KV cache bugs and quantization degradation that short benchmarks hide.</li>
<li><a href="https://github.com/MoonshotAI/K2-Vendor-Verifier" class="text-(--Colors-KMBlue) hover:underline" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">K2VV ToolCall</a>: Measures trigger consistency (F1) and JSON Schema accuracy. Tool errors compound in agents; we catch them early.</li>
<li>SWE-Bench: Full agentic coding test. (Not open sourced due to dependency of sandbox)</li>
</ol>
<p><strong class="font-semibold text-(--Labels-Primary)">Upstream Fix</strong>: We embed with vLLM/SGLang/KTransformers communities to fix root causes, not just detect symptoms.</p>
<p><strong class="font-semibold text-(--Labels-Primary)">Pre-Release Validation</strong>:
Rather than waiting for post-deployment complaints, we provide early access to test models. This lets infrastructure providers validate their stacks before users encounter issues.</p>
<p><strong class="font-semibold text-(--Labels-Primary)">Continuous Benchmarking</strong>:
We will maintain a public leaderboard of vendor results. This transparency encourages vendors to prioritize accuracy.</p>
<h2 node="[object Object]">Testing Cost Estimation</h2>
<p>We completed full evaluation workflow validation on Two NVIDIA H20 8-GPU servers, with sequential execution taking approximately 15 hours. To improve evaluation efficiency, scripts have been optimized for long-running inference scenarios, including streaming inference, automatic retry, and checkpoint resumption mechanisms.</p>
<h2 node="[object Object]">An Open Invitation</h2>
<p><strong class="font-semibold text-(--Labels-Primary)">Weights are open. The knowledge to run them correctly must be too.</strong></p>
<p>We are expanding vendor coverage and seeking lighter agentic tests. <strong class="font-semibold text-(--Labels-Primary)">Contact Us: <a href="mailto:contact-kvv@kimi.com" class="text-(--Colors-KMBlue) hover:underline" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">contact-kvv@kimi.com</a></strong></p></div></div></section></div></div><!--$--><!--/$--></main><footer
